versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text: 778(h) are being adopted to provide that the airplane crew be informed of the operation limitations established for the airplane; ¢.g., VFR day, IFR night, operation in icing conditions, ete. Miscellaneous changes of an editorial or clarifying nature are being made to §§ 3.1, 3.11(b), 3.82, 3.86, 3.174-1, 3.1743, 3.174-7, 3.216-5, 3.216-6, 3.301, 3.301-1, 3.301-2, 3.304-1, 3.345-3, 3.573, 3.582, 3.714, 3.744, 3.745, 3.746, 3.747, 3.767, 3.779, 3.780, 3.780-1, Figure 3-12(b), and the heading of subpart E. The miscellaneous amendments contain an amendment to §3.11(b) which excludes from the provisions of that section consideration of provisional type certificates. It was proposed that this be accomplished by a note. However, it now appears to be more appropriate to-include such a provision within § 3.11(b) rather than as a note thereto. Although not contained in the proposal, the heading of subpart Bis being corrected to read “Subpart E— Powerplant”, Interested persons have been afforded an opportunity to participate in the making of this amendment, and due consideration has been given to all relevant matter presented. In consideration of the foregoing, Part 3 of the Civil Air Regulations (14 CFR Part 3, as amended) is hereby amended as follows, effective May 3, 1962: i. By amending the title of § 3.1(f) and by adding a new subparagraph (9) to read as follows:
